description: Ministry of Strategic Development & International Trade - Correction notice for the Gaz. Ex. No. 2049/59 of 15.12.2017 that published under the Strategic Development Project Act
reasoning: This gazette content is a correction notice for the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008. It specifically corrects a printing error in a previous legal publication. The content deals with the amendment/correction of a statutory instrument (an Order under Section 3), which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
